name: VN-MSASar
description: This record accompanies the manuscript "Auditing evaluation on benchmarks annotated by large language models: label noise, source enrichment and design-based correction in multilingual sarcasm and aspect sentiment analysis" (Pham, Huynh and Tran), submitted to Expert Systems: The Journal of Knowledge Engineering. VN-MSASar is a four-language (Vietnamese, English, Chinese, Japanese) benchmark of hotel and restaurant reviews labelled for aspect, sentiment level (-3 to +3) and sarcasm with LLM assistance. This version adds the material needed to check how far scores computed against those machine labels change when the labels are replaced by human judgement. The package contains:- the benchmark splits (8,227 aspect-sentence pairs in the test set);- a blind human audit of 1,500 test pairs, stratified by the machine labels and by data source, with sampling weights and the returned files of four independent annotators;- stored per-example predictions of every evaluated model (fine-tuned encoders and prompted LLMs, with prompts and raw outputs), so no model endpoint has to be called again;- the analysis code that produces every table and figure, including the prediction-powered (PPI) and Horvitz-Thompson estimators, the Shapley decomposition of the enriched versus natural precision gap, and all simulations;- the outputs of every analysis and simulation, with a key_results folder that maps each file to a table or figure of the manuscript.
